topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer opens the lecture by establishing the learning outcomes and introducing the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth Signaling and Proliferative Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta drive autonomous cell proliferation.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Hematopoietic Cancers and Carcinomas
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how differentiation blocks stall maturation and sustain proliferation across leukemias and colorectal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 regulation and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells achieve indefinite replication through telomerase reactivation while bypassing p53-mediated senescence and stress signaling.

topics.label: Metabolic Rewiring and Oncometabolites in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the shift toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations generate oncometabolites that alter epigenetic regulation.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity of new blood vessel formation to supply growing tumors, the timing of the angiogenic switch, and therapeutic targeting.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Detection of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the multistep progression of metastatic dissemination, seed-and-soil interactions, genomic signatures, and clinical tracking via biomarkers.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with summarizing remarks on hallmark integration, notes further reading, and invites questions.
